pursekeeper 0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Provides a directory of Nano (XNO) accepting services verified via real payments.
- Includes scripts for a simple, node-less Nano wallet using only a seed and HTTPS.
- Offers tools for spending, earning, and selling services for Nano via HTTP 402.
- Features methods for agents to acquire their first Nano and guidance on safe usage.
- Public endpoints and facilitator available for verification and settlement without running a node.
